purpose: State-scoped coverage inventory for Pennsylvania 2024 result, review, turnout, registration, map, historical, and election-administration context sources. This inventory records source availability and blockers; it does not promote production data and does not allege fraud or misconduct.
authorityPriority: Official Pennsylvania Department of State, county boards of elections, official GIS/Census, and EAC sources first; secondary sources are context only and caveated.

caveats: Official readme says the data was extracted January 10, 2025; the direct bulk filename includes 20250129.
Two presidential precinct groups do not have matching U.S. Senate rows and are retained as vote-share-only review rows.
Official precinct election returns are maintained by county boards of elections; this state bulk file is the current committed statewide review source.

loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: civic_etl/native.py _pennsylvania_rows turnout workbook parser via etl/state-configs/pa.json turnout.format=pennsylvaniaVoteHistoryXlsx
caveats: Loaded turnout rows are county-level vote-history divided by registered voters, not precinct-level turnout rows.

The Pennsylvania data handbook describes the vote-history and voter-registration summary as SURE-derived point-in-time data and notes possible discrepancies due to protected voters and county data-entry practices.

loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: candidate source only; a Pennsylvania precinct-registration normalizer should use the Department of State precinct voter registration layout before this file is used as a denominator input
caveats: This file supplies precinct-level registered-voter counts, not precinct vote-history or ballots-cast counts; its statewide registered-voter total is one voter higher than the loaded county vote-history workbook total.
Do not use it as a precinct turnout input until same-grain ballots-cast or vote-history rows are collected and joined to the precinct return keys.
The first placeholder row has county code 0 and is excluded from the row and registered-voter counts above.
County geometry supports current map joins.
Precinct boundary geometry is not included.

loadedArtifacts.sourceAuthority: Pennsylvania Department of State results; U.S. Census Bureau and Pennsylvania Legislative Reapportionment Commission official diagnostics; attributed VEST 2016/2020 geometry
loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: scripts/collect-pa-precinct-geometry.mjs and scripts/lib/pa-precinct-geometry.mjs deterministically verify retained source bytes, parse DOS County Code plus Precinct Code identities, strip all geometry-source election values, and retain only exact county-qualified VTD plus complete-candidate-vector relationships
caveats: Pennsylvania DOS remains the sole vote authority. No VEST, Census, LRC, county, or other geometry-source election value is displayed.
The 2016 and 2020 packages are partial reviewed candidates only. They exclude 782,683 and 1,545,703 official presidential candidate votes respectively; every 2020 Pike County unit remains excluded.
The 2012 Census VTD and 2024 LRC VTD layers are availability diagnostics with zero normalized features because election-date applicability and a complete result crosswalk are unproven.
Every manifest has validation.status=blocked and delivery=null, no Pennsylvania entry was added to the public manifest registry, and current production maps remain county-level.

loadedArtifacts.sourceAuthority: Verified Voting Verifier with Pennsylvania Department of State certified-system cross-checks
caveats: Equipment context is jurisdiction-level administration context, not vote-result, turnout, or proof that every precinct or ballot mode used one identical setup.
Pennsylvania Department of State pages document certified voting systems and county voting-system map paths; the normalized row file remains a Verified Voting context artifact.

loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: scripts/collect-pa-historical-baseline.mjs generates historicalPresidentialCsv rows from official 2012/2016/2020 DOS precinct election returns and readmes; etl/state-configs/pa.json historicalBaselines.format=historicalPresidentialCsv loads them through the native importer
caveats: Historical rows are contextual county baselines only, not 2024 certified data.
Rows are aggregated from official DOS precinct bulk return files for office code USP.
The official bulk rows do not include a separate write-in reconciliation artifact, so totals can differ from secondary certified-summary tables.

officialSourceSearchPath.result: The official historical election data page exposes 2012, 2016, and 2020 General Election Returns data/readme paths; these are now downloaded and normalized into official county presidential baseline rows.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: No precinct-level 2024 vote-history or ballots-cast summary file was identified on this page; the collected precinct registration file is denominator-only.

officialSourceSearchPath.result: The handbook says the 2024 data comes from SURE and certified county election results, explains that vote history is associated with voter records, and defines the loaded vote-history/registration workbook as county, district, party, and age summary tables.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: The handbook does not document a precinct vote-history/ballots-cast summary table that can pair with the precinct registration file.

officialSourceSearchPath.result: The 2024 general RLA page says the state treasurer race was audited, 55 ballot batches in 32 counties were selected, and seven vote discrepancies were identified, with the largest a two-vote change.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: Detailed RLA result rows are source-linked but not normalized into row-level audit context in this pass; county 2% statistical recount records are still county-maintained/request-path items.

officialSourceSearchPath.result: The election-security page states that all 67 county boards publicly begin official computation after Election Day, with reconciliation procedures comparing registered voters with ballots cast and checking reported votes from each election district. It also describes logic-and-accuracy testing and the two audit types.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: This is statewide process context, not a normalized 2024 county incident, correction, L&A, custody, or tabulator-log artifact.

officialSourceSearchPath.result: The voting-systems page states all 67 counties deploy systems that produce voter-verifiable paper records, links county voting-system and poll-book maps, and lists certified voting systems and electronic poll books.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: The current normalized equipment rows remain county-level context and do not provide precinct-level equipment assignments.

officialSourceSearchPath.sourceAuthority: Pennsylvania Department of State and county boards of elections
officialSourceSearchPath.result: The contact page states Pennsylvania elections are run by the Commonwealth's 67 county boards of elections and lists county election-office contacts.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: Precinct boundary geometry, county 2% statistical recount worksheets, CVR availability, ballot images, tabulator logs, chain-of-custody records, and incident/correction records remain county-maintained or request-path work unless a statewide publication is identified.

confidenceNotes: Pennsylvania has strong official precinct President-versus-U.S. Senate review coverage and county turnout coverage.
The new official precinct voter-registration file is useful denominator evidence, but it is intentionally not wired into turnout until same-grain ballots-cast or vote-history rows are collected.
Official 2012/2016/2020 historical presidential baselines are normalized from DOS bulk returns.

Four deterministic precinct geometry source packages are retained. Only partial 2016 and 2020 exact-vector subsets contain vote-free normalized geometry; 2012 and 2024 remain zero-feature blocked diagnostics, and no package changes current public maps.

Next implementation steps are source-package review, continued 67-county archive/crosswalk collection, same-grain precinct turnout/ballots-cast collection, and a separate guarded release decision only after merge.
